title_en: National Academy of Engineering of Korea 'Value of Engineering' Short-Form Video Contest
summary: The National Academy of Engineering of Korea is holding a 'Value of Engineering' Short-Form Contest, which runs until Friday, 20 November. Only the title of this notice was provided; it does not state who may enter, how to enter or where to submit. Interested students should consult the original notice or the department office for full details.

dates.what: End of the contest (the title says the contest runs until this date; it does not state whether this is the submission deadline). The year is not stated; the notice was posted in November 2026.

steps: Read the full original notice and any attachments for eligibility, entry requirements and the submission method, because only the title was provided and no further content was read.
Contact the department office if you have questions; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
[National Academy of Engineering of Korea] 'Value of Engineering Short-Form Contest' (공학의 가치 숏폼 콘테스트) Being Held (until Friday, 11.20)

Note: Only the title of this notice was provided. The body text and any attachments or images were not available and were not read.
